@graph.name: Logistics Project Management Dataset
@graph.description: The dedicated dataset of the Logistics Project Management program of The Flat Rate Movers: scoped project execution for port, warehouse and industrial projects — survey, full scope, crew and sequence planning, supervised execution and closeout — at one flat rate in writing, with a single point of contact at the branch each project binds to. The dataset carries the eight ports of the company's port registry as typed Places with their bound branches and road bindings, the per-port Logistics Project Management Service nodes bound to the program hub, the bridge services the program runs on (transloading and container services, freight rework and cross-docking, specialized workforce, and 3PL support), and the 64-cell coverage matrix of ports by service columns generated from data/ports.json. Project types: container programs, warehouse load-outs and resets, surge programs, freight-rework campaigns and port-adjacent staging. Port work runs on TWIC-carded crews — every individual sent onsite holds their own TWIC card and proper ID — dispatched 24/7 at contract scale. Scoped project execution only: the company does not sell transportation management, brokerage or drayage, and no rate is published in this dataset; pricing is per job, one flat rate agreed in writing before work starts.

@graph.name: Logistics Project Management
@graph.description: Logistics project management for port, warehouse and industrial projects: survey, full scope, crew and sequence planning, supervised execution and closeout for container programs, warehouse load-outs and resets, surge programs, freight-rework campaigns and port-adjacent staging — run from the bound branch at the eight ports the company serves. Scoped project execution only; not transportation management, brokerage or drayage. Every engagement is quoted per job at one flat rate in writing, with a single point of contact at the bound branch from survey through closeout.

@graph.name: Loading, Transloading and Container Services
@graph.description: Container loading and unloading, and transloading between truck, container and warehouse — counted, sorted and restacked for the inland leg, with cross-docking and warehouse staging. Run inside the logistics project management program at one flat rate in writing.

@graph.name: Freight Rework & Transloading
@graph.description: Freight rework and transloading from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV — shifted loads, loads refused at a receiver's dock, damaged or collapsed pallets, and overweight or axle-illegal loads, unloaded under control, documented as found, rebuilt to the receiver's specification and re-secured to the federal cargo securement standard, plus planned cross-docking and container and rail-to-truck transloading — for drivers, carriers, brokers, 3PLs, warehouses and receivers, quoted at one flat rate before work begins, with emergency and after-hours response available at premium rates. The work is performed where the job requires: leased space, the receiver's dock, or a yard. No rate schedule is published for this service. Quoted flat in writing through the same flat-rate quote path, from Winchester VA and Martinsburg WV. Run inside the logistics project management program at one flat rate in writing.

@graph.name: Industrial & Commercial Services
@graph.description: Industrial & Commercial Services — Trained, Supervised Moving and Warehouse Teams for industrial and commercial project support: warehouse and distribution, commercial relocation and logistics including white-glove/blanket-wrap, FF&E installation and project support, and flexible workforce deployment, priced per job with no required contract duration. Standard Job Pricing: Unload $8.00/CWT, Load $10.00/CWT, APU $12.00/CWT, Residential/Driver Meet $400-$425 per man. Run inside the logistics project management program at one flat rate in writing.

@graph.name: 3PL Support Services
@graph.description: The Flat Rate Movers support 3PL operations with contract labor from our Winchester VA and Martinsburg WV branches — flat rate in writing, guaranteed, call (540) 422-2153. Container unloading and devanning, pallet breakdown and rebuild, labeling, sorting, shrink-wrap and palletizing, inventory counts, cross-dock, transloading, kitting and co-packing — TWIC-carded crews, dispatched 24/7 to all eight ports in the port program. Run inside the logistics project management program at one flat rate in writing.
